file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Bristol MB ChB Medicine A100. This file preserves the approved Bristol research document, evidence classifications, implementation mapping and known review boundaries; executable rules live in data/universities/bristol-a100.json.

research_scope.historical_guidance_cycle: 2026 entry published thresholds with older converted context
research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: /Users/faizan/Desktop/medical university research/bristol.docx supplied by the user on 2026-07-13
research_scope.notes: The existing repository profile was an MSC seed with unknown rules. It has been replaced with the approved research-backed production profile.

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to a first-party University of Bristol source.
evidence_classification_policy.official_published_threshold: A UCAT threshold directly published by the University of Bristol for a named entry cycle.
evidence_classification_policy.foi_derived: A figure obtained from or derived from Freedom of Information evidence as labelled in the approved research.
evidence_classification_policy.converted_historical_figure: A score originally published on the previous 3600-point UCAT scale and converted proportionally to the current 2700-point scale for comparison only.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: A cycle-labelled observation used to position interview competitiveness, never as a current guarantee.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.intake_caveat: The user designated the completed Bristol research document as authoritative. Source classifications preserve its evidence log and caveats.

metadata.repository_discrepancy_reported_before_e: Existing Bristol A100 production JSON was a low-confidence MSC seed with unknown GCSE, A-level, UCAT and shortlisting rules; the production implementation replaces it with the approved research-backed UCAT-only model.

route_limited_blockers: Bristol sets annual UCAT thresholds dynamically after the UCAS deadline, so future thresholds cannot be predicted deterministically.
Several older UCAT thresholds are converted historical figures from the legacy 3600-point scale and are approximate comparison values only.
Country-specific international qualification equivalences are not tabulated in the approved research.
Post-interview MMI score distributions, maximum score and offer cut-off scores are not published.
Reserve-list numbers and activation rates are not routinely published.
engine_execution_boundaries: Scottish Higher plus Advanced Higher eligibility is documented but remains manual review because the generic classifier cannot safely evaluate the joint profile.
Graduate A100 eligibility is documented as a 2:1 degree plus BBB school-qualification branch, but remains manual review because the generic classifier does not combine both conditions.
Contextual IB is documented but remains manual review for automatic classification.
Country-specific international qualification equivalences require institution-verified evidence.

The Profile A English-language policy contains multiple school-qualification, test and exemption variants; the generic classifier requires verified exemption or manually reviewed evidence for non-standard routes.
readiness.summary: Official evidence supports scoped A100 eligibility and pool-specific UCAT interview guidance for Home, International and verified University of Bristol widening participation programme applicants.

steps: Require UCAT for the relevant application cycle.
Rank eligible ordinary applicants by UCAT cognitive total only within separate Home and International pools.
Apply verified Bristol widening participation guaranteed-interview handling where published criteria are met.
Do not use SJT, GCSE scoring, predicted-grade scoring or personal statements.

gcse.minimum_profile: GCSE English Language grade 4/C and Mathematics grade 7/A.
gcse.resits: Accepted to meet minimum academic entry requirements.

a_level.contextual: ABB including A in Chemistry and B in the second required science or maths subject
a_level.subject_rule: Chemistry plus one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.

international_baccalaureate.standard: 36 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including 6 and 6 in Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
international_baccalaureate.contextual: 32 points overall with 16 at Higher Level, including 6 at HL Chemistry and 5 at HL in one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

scottish.standard: AAAAB Highers plus AA Advanced Highers including Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

graduate_a100.requirement: 2:1 degree in any subject plus BBB at A-level including Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.

english_language.ielts: 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each skill
documented_exemptions: GCSE English Language grade B or 6
GCSE English Literature grade A or 7
IGCSE English as a First Language grade A or 7
Accepted IB or A-level English qualification
Nationality or recent study in a UKVI recognised English-speaking country

historical_context.warning: Historical UCAT thresholds are guidance only and must never be presented as guaranteed future cut-offs.

contextual_and_widening_participation.notes: Standard contextual applicants do not receive a guaranteed interview. Recognised Bristol WP programme completers may receive one when the published criteria are met.
